notes: Native reported score is normalized to0..1; report_score_100 multiplies by100.
Score15 is an intermediate predicate transition, not15percent task success probability or proof of full task completion.
The score checks involve gripper opening, basket/category containment and height/exclusion predicates; do not translate15points into a number of objects without checking reward predicate evidence.
Fullsuccess comes from the independent native success flag, not from nonzero partial score.
